description:
Tune in for the third and deciding battle in this season of Trazyn’s Tesseract Trials to see the tanks of the Astra Militarum face off against monstrous Tyranid bioforms in a series of brutal combat challenges. You can also find out how the Necron-themed board was created for this episode in Da Mekboy's Workshop and explore the history of the War for the Cadian Gate in Loremasters. 

Find out more here: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/ai1xywzl/astra-militarum-vs-tyranids-in-trazyns-prismatic-galleries/
